name: @sand/features
description: Turns sand's features and add-ons on and off: the Add-ons settings page, and the home screen while nothing fills it

sand.label: Features
sand.summary: Turn add-ons like Coding or Calendar on, and the rest of sand off

threads.label: Threads
threads.summary: Work with agents in your project folders, with subagents and background commands

threads-mcp.label: Thread tools
threads-mcp.summary: Threads and bots start, message and read threads, manage projects, list models, and see plugins and turn add-ons on

bots.label: Bots
bots.summary: Assistants with their own job, memory and model that you chat with

routines.label: Routines
routines.summary: Bots remind you and do things on a schedule

bots-mcp.label: Bot tools
bots-mcp.summary: Threads and bots message, read and update your bots

bridge.label: Bots and threads
bridge.summary: Threads ask your bots, and bots start and message threads

side-panel.label: Side panel
side-panel.summary: A panel at a chat's right with tabs for its plan, memory, Logbook and changes

plan-tab.label: Plan tab
plan-tab.summary: A bot's plan, live and editable

memory-tab.label: Memory tab
memory-tab.summary: A bot's memory and notes, or the shared memory of a thread's project, live and editable

phone.label: Phone
phone.summary: Pair your phone and use sand from it, on your home wifi or over Tailscale

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.summary: Tell you when something finishes, fails or needs you

updates.label: Updates
updates.summary: Install newer sand releases on every PC

models.label: Models
models.summary: Sign in to AI providers and pick models

engine.label: Agent engine
engine.summary: Runs agent turns: model replies, tool calls and the system prompt

compaction.label: Compaction
compaction.summary: Summarizes a long conversation before its context fills up
compaction.stops: Long conversations stop when their context fills up instead of being summarized.

memory.label: Memory
memory.summary: Memory that lasts across conversations, for threads and bots
memory.stops: Threads and bots don't remember anything from one conversation to the next.

watch.label: Folder watching
watch.summary: Notices changes in folders for other parts

background.label: Background model
background.summary: A model for titles, summaries and commit messages
background.stops: Titles, summaries and commit messages are no longer written for you.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.summary: Files and images attached to messages, and copying files between PCs
attachments.stops: You can't attach files or images to messages.

file-tools.label: File tools
file-tools.summary: Agents read, write, edit and search files
file-tools.stops: Agents can't read, write or search files.

web-tools.label: Web tools
web-tools.summary: Agents search the web and read pages
web-tools.stops: Agents can't search the web or read pages.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.summary: How conversations show: messages, pages and the work behind them

composer.label: Composer
composer.summary: Where you write messages: completions, commands, attachments and drafts

html.label: HTML pages
html.summary: Charts, tables and mockups agents show inline in the chat
html.stops: Agents can't show pages in the chat.

schedules.label: Schedules
schedules.summary: Runs things at set times, even after a restart

usage.label: Usage
usage.stops: Plan limits, cost and tokens are no longer shown.

usage-resume.label: Resume at reset
usage-resume.summary: A chat that runs out of usage picks up again by itself when it resets, and what you send it meanwhile waits until then
usage-resume.stops: A chat that runs out of usage stays stopped until you send it something again.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.summary: Find things and run actions from the keyboard
palette.stops: The command palette and its actions go away.

picker.label: Pickers
picker.summary: Lists and boxes for choosing, renaming and confirming
picker.stops: Boxes for choosing, renaming and confirming go away.

extend.label: Plugin writing
extend.summary: Agents learn to write new plugins
extend.stops: Agents don't learn how to write plugins.

mcp-server.label: sand's tools
mcp-server.summary: Tools that let threads and bots work sand itself, like starting threads, messaging bots or turning add-ons on
mcp-server.stops: Threads and bots can't use sand's own tools, like starting threads, messaging bots or turning add-ons on.
